# A path without a trailing slash above an alias directive traverses upwards.
# A directive follows the alias line: the block pattern needs trailing
# content before the closing brace.
# ruleid: alias-path-traversal
location /static {
  alias /var/www/static/;
  autoindex off;
}
# ok: alias-path-traversal
location /static/ {
  alias /var/www/static/;
  autoindex off;
}
# ruleid: alias-path-traversal
location /images {
  alias /var/www/images/;
  autoindex off;
}
# ok: alias-path-traversal
location /health {
  proxy_pass http://example.com/;
  autoindex off;
}
